canonical_purpose: Provide an installable deterministic local multi-tile thermal scenario laboratory with bounded Python gradient/ablation/integrity analysis and a natively compiled/executed Odin data-oriented reference.
natural_runtime: installable local Python library/CLI plus native Odin reference executable
deployment_reason: Flight, test-stand, TPS, or physical-control deployment would add external telemetry, calibration, safety, and authority requirements outside the repository-owned local scenario purpose.
